context: We report our experience using this technique to bridge colonic gaps after significant loss of bowel length. PATIENTS AND METHODS Between 1999 and 2009 the left-sided colon was too short for traditional isoperistaltic reconstruction in six patients treated in our hospital. Reasons for extensive bowel loss were a deficient (n = 3) or torn (n = 1) marginal artery with ischemia or repeat colorectal resections (n = 2).
target: An ICI was done to bridge the gap and enable restoration of intestinal continuity.
